noop.why: Upstream forwards the chosen locale to main so it can relabel the native application menu. There is no native menu here, and the renderer's own react-intl catalogue is what the user actually sees.

getLedgerAddresses.why: Read once while the wallet view mounts, so it answers rather than refuses: an fp-ts Right holding no addresses, which is the truth. Refusing here would take the wallet page down on load instead of showing no Ledger accounts.

getLedgerAddress.why: Reads an address off the device through @ledgerhq/hw-transport-node-hid-singleton, in the main process. Chromium has WebHID, but reaching it would mean writing a Ledger transport into this bridge -- docs/porting-guide.md's own "when to stop".

verifyLedgerAddress.why: Asks the device to show an address on its screen. Same transport, same absence.

sendLedgerTx.why: Signs and broadcasts from the device.

depositLedgerTx.why: Signs and broadcasts a THORChain deposit from the device.

approveLedgerERC20Token.why: Signs an ERC-20 approval from the device.

saveLedgerAddresses.why: Persists addresses read off a device. Nothing can produce them here, so writing them is refused rather than silently accepted -- an empty list that looked saved would read as "no Ledger accounts" rather than "no Ledger".

checkForAppUpdates.why: A port's version is its pinned commit, so there is never a newer desktop release to report -- RD.success(O.none) says exactly that, and it is true rather than a placeholder. It answers rather than refusing because useAppUpdate.ts passes this call's result straight into Rx.from, so a synchronous throw would escape its own catchError and surface as an uncaught error during mount. api.github.com stays out of orivon.json either way.

init.why: Called while the vault manager mounts. Answering { initialized: false } is what the app's own code reads as "the SDK is not up", which is exactly true here.

dispose.why: The teardown half of init. Nothing was started, so nothing is torn down -- but it resolves, because it is awaited on unmount.

cancelKeygen.why: Cancels a key-generation round. None can start, and a cancel that threw would be a cleanup path failing louder than the thing it cleans up.

listVaults.why: The roster the vault UI renders. An empty list is the honest answer and the one that lets the page mount showing no vaults.

isVaultUnlocked.why: Whether a vault's password is still cached. There are no vaults, so it never is.

createFastVault.why: Creating a vault runs the Vultisig SDK's key generation against a relay, in the main process. There is no vault path in this port, so this is where it says so.

createSecureVault.why: The device-pairing half of vault creation. Same SDK, same absence.

verifyVault.why: Confirms a fast vault's e-mail code against the SDK. Unreachable without a vault to verify.

deleteVault.why: Deletes vault material the SDK stores outside the app's own directory.

renameVault.why: Renames vault material this port never created.

getAddresses.why: Derives a vault's addresses through the SDK. Takes a vaultId, and listVaults never hands one out.

getBalances.why: Reads a vault's balances through the SDK. Same vaultId, same absence.

importVault.why: Imports a .vult file into the SDK's own store, which is not the app's directory and not reachable through orivon.fs.

exportVault.why: Writes vault material out through the SDK. Resolves a filePath upstream, which is the escape test's own failure case as well as an absent capability.

openVaultFile.why: A native open dialog feeding the SDK. orivon.fs.userSelected could offer the file, but there is no SDK behind it to take it.

lockVault.why: Clears the SDK's password cache. No SDK, no cache.

unlockVault.why: Fills the SDK's password cache. Reached only from a vault this port cannot have.

signBytes.why: Signs through multi-party computation across the SDK and a paired device. The whole point of the group, and the whole of what is missing.

sendTransaction.why: Signs and broadcasts through the SDK. Refusing here is what keeps a half-built signing path from ever being reached.

cancelSigning.why: Cancels a signing round that cannot start.
